text: Farmers and truckers have blocked highways and ports in southern Italy to protest rising fuel prices, NBC News reports.

sources.title: Italy’s PM deploys troops as nation faces widespread strikes and port blockades - NBC News
sources.articleText:
ROME — Tens of thousands of people took to the streets of Rome, Milan and other Italian cities Friday as part of nationwide demonstrations against the cost of living and high military spending.
The demonstrations were largely peaceful but an NBC News crew saw police use a water cannon on protestors and groups of police charging to disperse protestors in Rome on Friday night.
After several weeks of violent protests in Italy and throughout Europe , more widespread disruption is expected after the Unione Sindacale di Base (USB) and other trade unions called on workers in both the public and private sectors to strike and protest.
